kitDescription: Rem is a Water MG Supporter whose burst is a Rocket-Launcher support package: casting it puts her into Demon's Breath for 10 seconds, raising her own Critical Rate by 37.8%, and grants every Rocket-Launcher ally a flat attack bonus equal to 50.78% of Rem's ATK plus 5 extra rounds of max ammunition for 10 seconds. While Demon's Breath is active, every 15 normal attacks she lands gives her a stacking 4.22% ATK buff (up to 30 stacks, each lasting 10 seconds), so her personal damage ramps inside each post-burst window. The rest of her kit is sustain: she continuously heals herself for 42.24% of the damage she deals, continuously shares HP recovery with herself and the two highest-final-ATK Rocket-Launcher allies, and shares HP recovery across the whole team for 10 seconds whenever she bursts. In game terms she is a low personal-damage enabler whose real contribution is amping RL teammates (caster-scaled flat ATK and magazine size) while providing team healing.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs found. All four damage-relevant lines (burst self critRatePct 37.8, burst RL casterAtkPct 50.78 flat-resolved, burst RL maxAmmoFlat 5, and the Demon's-Breath-gated skill1 ATK stack 4.22x30) are encoded faithfully on value/scope/trigger/duration, corroborated identically by two independent blind re-derivations; the three heal/HP-share lines are DOCUMENTED_GAPs (verbatim unmodeled + guard PINs + a conditional tandem-live recipe ⚑4), which is the correct treatment for a damage-only model with no HP pool — the reviewer's tandem-live concern is conditional on a recovery consumer the driver's fixture deliberately excludes. Convergence is real but was earned honestly: the verbatim S5 run went RED for a fixture reason (crown out-competes Rem for the Burst-II slot, vacuating every burst-keyed assertion), the blind test's own canary diagnosed exactly this and sanctioned the re-fixture, after which all 12 substantive assertions passed unmodified — this is a fixture artifact, not encoding disagreement. The two blind S6 divergences are blind-side weaknesses, not driver defects: the 'mode:demonsBreath' gate primitive is not demonstrated to exist in the engine (the driver's targetStatus proxy validates and is behaviorally proven), and rampSec:8 is an unmeasured haircut the driver rightly refused (MEASURED > FUDGE). Discrimination holds: every load-bearing assertion has a named counterfactual that goes the wrong way (scope-allies, stat-swap, gate-dropped, buff-removed), and S5's strip tests prove the RL grants are load-bearing on ada and inert elsewhere. The same-model residual the owner should spot-check: every agent independently read 'Demon's Breath' as the 10s window opened by Rem's own burst and the S1 stacks as confined to it — the kit implies but never states the source, the per-window hit-counter reset (⚑2), or the per-stack-vs-pool-refresh timer semantics; a short focused-video read of first-stack timing relative to her burst would settle all three at once. Also note ⚑1's name-keyed boss targetStatus side channel is inert today but should be replaced by a requiresOwnBuff primitive before any second 'Demon's Breath' carrier enters scope. Nothing must change for GO.
